## Release type

Merging to `main` triggers a release. Set exactly one release label (the bot comment on this PR shows the version it will produce):

- [ ] `patch` - bug fix, tweak, refactor (default if unlabeled)
- [ ] `minor` - new feature or meaningful behaviour change
- [ ] `major` - breaking change

Tip: `gh pr create --fill --label minor`
